name: Nakayama Hinako
source:
"Stop. I don't want to fight in any meaningless battles."

[Class] First Year Sumiregumi (Violet)
[Specialty] General Martial Arts

For as long as she's known she's been under the care of the state and, according to their policies, she's learned various martial arts since childhood. Ever since meeting her [url=/c39879]twin brother[/url], who suddenly appeared, she's become enrolled in this prefecture's only high school for delinquents, Shishiku Academy, in her brother's place.

[Translation taken from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/11/14/kenka-banchou-otome/]Otome Jikan[/url].]
